newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-Analysts see no Bank/Portugal cut Friday.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts see no Bank/Portugal cut Friday.

text.p: Five out of seven analysts polled by Reuters said they did not expect the Bank of Portugal to cut its repurchase pact rate when it announces conditions later on Friday for the next commercial bank reserve period.
All the analysts, however, said that there was room for a cut in the future.
1. Will the Bank cut on Friday? 2. If it cuts, by how much? 3. Could it cut the drain or emergency lending rates? 4. Is there room for future cuts?
The following banks and brokerages taking part in the poll were willing to be identified: Banco de Comercio & Industria, Banco Mello de Investimento, Fincor, Siemca.
